LanguageData.BOR_HolytechExitText: The psychosis has broken {PAWN_labelShort} too many times. Their tenebral bionics can now be removed by surgery, which opens the path of the Holytech.\n\nIf the breaks go on, {PAWN_possessive} body will start to crystallize.
LanguageData.BOR_HolytechCandidate: {0} is free of tenebral bionics. The Holytech path is open.
LanguageData.BOR_CrystallizationText: {PAWN_labelShort} has broken too often under the psychosis. {PAWN_possessive} body has begun turning to black crystal, one part at a time. Crystallized parts stop working and cannot be removed.\n\nOnce half of the body has crystallized, {PAWN_labelShort} can be placed in an Umbral Transformation Pod.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralEmergedText: The pod opens. {PAWN_labelShort} is Umbral now: {PAWN_possessive} body will take no more surgery, and it will keep changing with every kill.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralPodModeDesc: Switch the pod between stasis, healing and operating.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralPodNeedsTenebral: healing needs someone with tenebral implants
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralPodChooseDesc: Choose what to install, and where. This works with nobody inside, so a colonist can set up their own operation, load the pod and climb in. Colonists load the tenebral organ or appendage and the femtoclusters it needs; the operation starts once someone is inside and ends by opening the pod.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralPodDoesNotFit: The chosen part can't take this operation on {0}.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralPodWaitingForPatient: Waiting for someone to lie down inside.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralPodCancelDesc: Cancel the operation and drop whatever was loaded for it.
LanguageData.BOR_AltarLockedTip: {0}\n\nSealed. Click to have a psychotic colonist unseal it ({1} of work). Click again to cancel.
LanguageData.BOR_AltarUnlocked: The altar gave up the design for {0}.
LanguageData.BOR_ExoModeDesc:
Change the exoskeleton's form.

Camo: unseen, but unable to handle anything.
Utility: no armor, works much faster.
Combat: very heavy armor, works much slower.
LanguageData.BOR_ExoBlocksApparel: the Umbral exoskeleton leaves no room for clothing
LanguageData.BOR_UtilityPodModeDesc: Change the shape of the utility pod.
LanguageData.BOR_PodBlocksWeapon: the Umbral utility pod holds no other weapon
